turns.question: How many delivery-topic customer service calls were there per 100 shipped orders in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no calls-per-100-shipped-orders metric, so I can't give that ratio; the closest metrics are calls_labelled (filtered to topic delivery: 1 delivery-topic call, 1-30 September 2026) and orders_total (filtered to status shipped: 50 shipped orders, 1-30 September 2026). Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
